# 00000001159

**English.** Definition: A junior group is a subgroup generated by elements of order p. Conjecture: The number of conjugacy classes of elements in the prime spectrum of a semisimple Lie group is an explicit polynomial; and the degree of the polynomial is a linear function of the rank. (prime-spectrum conjugacy polynomial)

**中文。** 定义：junior 群为由阶 p 元素生成的子群。猜想：半单李群的素数谱的元素共轭类数为显式多项式；且多项式的次数为秩的线性函数。（素谱共轭多项式）
